## ARTICLE XII JURY DUTY

### Section A. Eligibility

1. A regular full-time employee who has completed the Probationary Period and is required by the court to be absent from work for service on a jury or examination for Jury Duty shall receive for each regular workday so spent, eight (8) hours pay at the employee's straight time base hourly rate, exclusive of any premium or shift differential.
